<a id="building_kind_hit"></a>
### [`building_kind_hit`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L6) `$4003`

*variable*

Game variables $4003-$40f7. The image holds the values of the cracker's capture; game start sets most of them.
Hit flag per building kind 0-3. 1: $7001 draws the kind with dithered chars. $6796 sets it; $4d64 clears it for a new building.

- **Read by:** [`animate_chars`](../screen/animate_chars.md#animate_chars) [`$7063`](../../../../src/screen/animate_chars.asm#L58)
